subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or close the open conflicting fork PR before a fresh narrow fix is allowed for this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open closing PR still exists outside the main repository and automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address the current Debug page structure with localized copy and tests.

options.title: Adopt and rebase fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against the current Debug page/view split before review.

recommendation.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address the current Debug page structure with localized copy and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal for the original Debug controller/view behavior.
